title: AI Data Governance Engineer- Manager
job_description:
The Opportunity
As an AI Data Governance Engineer- Manager, you will help clients make data more trustworthy and useful for decision-making within our Advisory practice. In this role, you will develop governance approaches that connect data to clear business definitions, ownership, and controls. You will work across data strategy and master data management, using governed metadata, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs to give data the context needed for analytics and AI. Your work will also draw on data analysis and visualization to help clients identify insights, improve data quality, and address complex business questions.
As a Manager, you will lead client workstreams with accountability for planning, budgets, timelines, and deliverables. You will apply independent judgment when reviewing work, examining how governance, data platforms, and analytical methods interact, and resolving issues with clients and colleagues. Coaching team members and drawing on their different strengths will be central to how you deliver quality and build capability. You will cultivate client relationships, identify opportunities to improve delivery through technology, and reinforce professional standards, integrity, and PwC's values in your decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading client workstreams that translate business priorities into data governance requirements and delivery plans for AI and analytics initiatives
- Designing governance frameworks and data operating models that define stewardship, accountability, metadata practices, and controls for data quality, security, and compliance
- Developing master data management approaches that reconcile critical business data across sources and establish consistent definitions for analysis and AI applications
- Building business ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers that connect governed metadata to business relationships and support AI explainability
- Directing data integration and manipulation to prepare large datasets for complex analysis, statistical modeling, visualization, and client decision-making
- Evaluating data readiness for AI applications, identifying gaps in definitions and context, and recommending improvements to information flows
- Reviewing analytical outputs and governance deliverables with team members, providing specific feedback on methods, documentation, and interpretation of data-driven insights
- Managing workstream schedules and resources while communicating findings, trade-offs, and delivery risks to clients and project leaders
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
What Sets You Apart
- Meeting this academic preference: Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Engineering, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Computer and Information Science, Economics, Finance
- Holding a credential meeting this criterion: At least one of the following: a Certification in databases (Databricks, MS SQL), visualization tools (Power BI), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), or predictive modeling/ML (Python, SAS)
- Designing governance frameworks and data integration approaches for AI-ready business data
- Understanding and practical experience in ontology development and management
- Designing and implementing knowledge graphs using technologies such as RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or similar
- Familiarity with semantic layer creation, conceptual modeling, and query optimization
- Applying complex data analysis and translating findings into client insights
- Guiding teams through master data management and governed metadata initiatives
- Coaching colleagues and communicating data quality findings to stakeholders
The salary range for this position is: $99,000 - $232,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Remote
job_description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Remote

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Senior ML Engineer to join our Data Science and Machine Learning department. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Data and Analytics team, where you'll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. Organization - Hyatt Corporate Office

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what's most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose-to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We're proud to have earned a place on Fortune's prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.
• Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
• Flexible work schedule
• Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
• A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
• Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. The Role

The Machine Learning Engineer partners with data science, data engineering, and platform teams to design, build, and operate scalable AI services. This role is responsible for translating machine learning models into reliable, production-grade systems through strong infrastructure design, MLOps automation, and performance optimization. The position also contributes to cross-functional initiatives that advance the organization's AI platform capabilities. Responsibilities
• Design and implement end-to-end ML systems, including data ingestion, feature processing, model training, and model serving
• Architect and deploy scalable AI services supporting real-time and batch inference use cases
• Build and maintain ML infrastructure across cloud environments (eg, EC2, EKS, SageMaker, specialized inference hardware)
• Develop and evolve MLOps platforms, including training pipelines, deployment workflows, feature stores, and model observability
• Implement CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code patterns to automate model lifecycle management
• Optimize model training and inference performance for cost, latency, and hardware efficiency
• Monitor production ML systems for accuracy, reliability, and operational health
• Partner cross-functionally with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to ensure compliant and scalable solutions
• Mentor team members on ML engineering, system design, and operational best practices
• Contribute to special initiatives that advance AI platform maturity and engineering standards Experience Required
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field
• 5+ years of experience building and operating machine learning solutions in cloud environments, with focus on AI services and MLOps foundations
• Demonstrated hands- on experience delivering end-to-end ML systems, spanning model development, deployment, and production infrastructure
• Proficiency with modern ML engineering tooling, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, and CI/CD workflows Experience Preferred
• Experience designing and scaling real-time and batch inference systems in production
• Hands- on experience with deep learning frameworks and model optimization for performance and cost
• Experience building or contributing to shared MLOps platforms, feature stores, or ML observability solutions
• Familiarity with cloud security, governance, and compliance standards

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $180,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards and an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

job_description:
[Data Engineer] Senior / Staff MLOps Engineer (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
ML Platform in Agoda
Agoda ML and AI Platform is built on self-managed Kubernetes and powered by Kubeflow, an open-source solution that enables efficient machine learning workflows.
Our AI Ops team combines the best practices of software engineering with data science to help Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists work more effectively, meaning we aim to incorporate data/model versioning, collaboration, monitoring etc. in an intuitive way that allows our users to prosper within the field.

In This Role, You’ll Get to:
• Lead the design, development, and implementation of on-premises MLOps solutions that support the delivery of machine learning models

• Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to build scalable and efficient data pipelines and model training and deployment systems

• Develop and maintain monitoring and management tools to ensure the reliability and performance of our on-premises MLOps infrastructure

• Work with stakeholders across the organization to understand their machine learning needs and requirements, and to develop MLOps solutions that meet those needs

• Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in MLOps, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, and share your knowledge with the team to help us stay at the forefront of the field

• Mentor junior members of the team and help them grow their skills and expertise in MLOps

• Troubleshooting and debugging user issues

What You’ll Need to Succeed
• 5+ years of experience in MLOps, Software engineering, Data engineering, or a related field

• Strong programming skills in a modern programming language (Java, Scala, Python, Kotlin)

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes—deploying and operating workloads (jobs, services, or ML/training pipelines), debugging pod failures, and working with core concepts (Deployments, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Services, resource limits)

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team environment

• Value code simplicity and performance

It’s Great if you have:
• Understanding of ML Projects lifecycle

• Experience with MLOps platforms, such as Kubeflow or MLFlow

• Experience with ML frameworks – like scikit-learn, LGBM, Tensorflow, PyTorch etc.

• Experience with Big Data tools – Spark, S3, Hadoop

• Strong knowledge of containerization and container orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices

• Has experience building and scaling model serving tools, i.e building APIs with tight SLAs

• Passion for the engineering behind machine learning, and scaling it

• Experience designing and building MLOps infrastructure, including data pipelines, model training and deployment systems, and monitoring and management tools.

AI Engineer - US Remote

About Maneva

Maneva is building the Thinking Factory: a factory floor that sees, understands, and acts on its own. Our Vision-to-Action AI turns video from off-the-shelf cameras into real-time decisions, with no rip-and-replace of existing infrastructure. We work with mid-market and enterprise manufacturers to deliver end-to-end outcomes, not dashboards:
• Higher yields: catch defects and process drift as they happen, and cut scrap and downtime.
• Closed-loop integration: connect vision insights directly to MES, PLC, and other production systems so findings trigger action.
• Safer, compliant floors: detect safety and compliance risks continuously, instead of relying on periodic audits.

Founded in 2022, Maneva raised a $27M Series A led by U.S. Venture Partners in June 2026 to push the frontier of our vision models, expand factory orchestration, and bring Thinking Factories to new industries and geographies. The models you build here will run on real production lines, where accuracy, latency, and reliability decide outcomes.
What you'll do
• Define the technical strategy and architecture for vision models across detection, VLM, and VLA workloads.
• Train, fine-tune, and adapt models (YOLO variants, open VLMs, VLA policies) on proprietary data, including distillation, quantization, and LoRA-style adaptation.
• Build data engines: labeling pipelines, auto-labeling with foundation models, active learning, and synthetic or simulated data.
• Design rigorous evaluation: benchmarks, regression suites, failure-mode analysis, and online metrics tied to product outcomes.
• Ship models to production under latency, memory, and cost limits, on cloud GPUs and edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, Jetson or similar).
• Lead cross-team technical projects; write design docs; review code and models; mentor senior and mid-level engineers.
• Track the research frontier, decide what is worth adopting, and turn it into prototypes and product.

Requirements
What we're looking for
• 5+ years building and shipping ML systems, with focus on computer vision; BS/MS/PhD in CS, EE, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Deep hands-on experience with object detection and segmentation (YOLO family, DETR-style models), including training, tuning, and production deployment.
• Hands-on experience with VLMs (for example LLaVA-, Qwen-VL-, or PaliGemma-style models): fine-tuning, prompting, grounding, and evaluation.
• Experience with VLAs or embodied and robot-learning models (for example OpenVLA-, RT-2-, or pi0-style policies), or a clear record in adjacent multimodal work.
• Strong PyTorch skills and fluency with distributed training, mixed precision, and GPU profiling.
• Track record of taking models from research to production: model optimization, inference serving, monitoring, and iteration on real-world failures.
• Evidence of staff-level impact: setting direction across teams, making sound build-versus-adopt calls, and raising the bar for others.
• Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, researchers, and product leaders.
Nice to have
• Publications or open-source contributions in vision or multimodal learning.
• Experience with video understanding, 3D perception, or multi-sensor fusion.
• Experience with simulation, sim-to-real transfer, or reinforcement and imitation learning.
• Edge and embedded deployment experience (TensorRT, CUDA, quantization-aware training).
• Experience with LLM tooling such as vLLM, or with RLHF-style post-training for multimodal models.
• This role may support work subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR). Access to certain projects may require U.S.-person status (U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee) or export authorization.
